paths.name: @hono/node-server
paths.message: Import serveHono from @conciv/serve, never @hono/node-server's serve — the wrapper bakes overrideGlobalObjects:false so a co-hosted engine never clobbers the host's global Response/Request (which breaks SSR realms, e.g. nitro rendering [object Response]). upgradeWebSocket may be imported directly.

patterns.message: Only packages/ai and packages/protocol may import @tanstack/ai*, and the conciv CLI @tanstack/ai-mcp for the hub; use @conciv/protocol and the @conciv/ai entries.

Import Ark UI components from @conciv/ui-kit-system, never @ark-ui directly — only ui-kit-system may wrap Ark UI. The headless hooks useListCollection / useFilter are the ONLY @ark-ui imports allowed elsewhere.
